lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are arranged in a series of horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with spot diameter generally increasing along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible lattice or grid-like configuration across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity luminance on the superior edge to localized shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance pixel clusters (commensal organisms) positioned near the ventral trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
